claims.title: Physical J1-J2 entanglement-depth certificates with a held-trial boundary

quoted_fields.interface: The source derives an exchange-square and two-replica reduction on the original spin-1/2 Heisenberg model, supplies five-site integer Gram certificates for a five-producible energy floor, and claims depth at least six using the reported earlier variational upper bound. A separate explicit four-spin trial gives weaker depth-three conclusions without that unavailable witness.
quoted_fields.failure: Source-authored physical-model certificate and producer-reported exact/independent integer replay, without an independent whole-science acceptance receipt. The claimed depth-six, temperature and stronger local-distance consequences also use a reported old 16-spin rational trial whose underlying witness/checker remain unreceived. No held ZIP retry or alternate transfer, Capital science execution, phase/priority or practical-advantage claim.
